purpose: Teach: ミート/ヘブライ/ボリシェヴィキ/ストリーミング/非対称/自滅/習熟/人力

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、加工肉ミートの保存料研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your processed meat preservative research — that was your paper topic, wasn't it?
lines.style: Calm, observant tone. Genuine curiosity, no edge. Warm acknowledgment of his work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、古代ヘブライ語文献の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote my paper on ancient Hebrew texts instead.
lines.style: Quiet correction, matter-of-fact. A small, self-aware smile underneath. Not defensive, just precise.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
